   850	        // Compute a region that fits both points with padding and minimum span to avoid over-zooming
   851	        let center = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: (user.latitude + dest.latitude) / 2,
   852	                                            longitude: (user.longitude + dest.longitude) / 2)
   853	        let baseLat = abs(user.latitude - dest.latitude)
   854	        let baseLon = abs(user.longitude - dest.longitude)
   855	        let paddedLat = max(baseLat * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.latitudeDelta)
   856	        let paddedLon = max(baseLon * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.longitudeDelta)
   857	        let span = MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: paddedLat, longitudeDelta: paddedLon)
   858	        return MKCoordinateRegion(center: center, span: span)
